p.title: Concentration weights were published as current while withheld positions had left the denominator
p.symptom: With some positions withheld (cached or reference quote) and no explicit total, the remaining weights were shares of the priced part only: each looked larger and a withheld largest holding was missing from the top weight, yet the status was current.
p.root_cause: P1536 withheld the position but kept the denominator rule of the earlier model.
p.fix: The result is 'partial' with the issue 'held-positions-excluded-from-denominator' and the weight basis 'priced-positions-only'; a complete set or an explicit total stays current.
p.violated_rule: Missing inputs are disclosed on the result, not only in a list.
p.prevention: ci-esm-core-unit-check P1561 (mixed set partial, priced set current, explicit total current).
